description: Search the Western Australia Data WA open data catalogue (CKAN) for datasets by keyword, e.g. query "transport": dataset titles, descriptions, publisher and links. Dataset discovery — dataset records themselves are downloaded from the portal; results link back to it. Source: Western Australia Data WA. License: CC BY / CC BY-SA / public domain — datasets filtered at the portal. Some datasets carry CC BY-SA marks — share-alike applies to derived works from those datasets.
